title: Playwright smoke test: load the app, open a score, press play
description:
There are no browser or end-to-end tests. Tests cover only pure models and helpers (`beat/model`, `chords/model`, `flow/layout|tween|story|lineage`, `rank-window`, `templates`, `account-state`, `route`). Every view (`ui/score.ts`, `ui/library.ts`, `ui/waveform.ts`, `ui/flow/view.ts`, `ui/flow/paint.ts`, `ui/chords/view.ts`, `ui/beat/view.ts`, `ui/breakdown/breakdown.ts`, `ui/docs.ts`, `ui/landing.ts`, `ui/account.ts`) and all of `src/audio/*` have zero tests.

Done when: a Playwright test builds the wasm and the app, serves them with the local backend, opens `examples/iv-of-ab-minor.apr`, presses play, and asserts the AudioContext is running and the chord strip is drawn; it runs in CI.
